snippet.title: The Bus | Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Bus is OUT NOW on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S!

Transport passengers along 1:1 scale routes in Berlin, passing landmarks like the Victory Column, Brandenburg Gate, and Alexanderplatz. In the Scania Citywide LF and other licensed buses, sell tickets, handle traffic, and get everyone to their destination safely. 

Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/491540/
PS5 👉 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016957
Xbox Series 👉 https://www.xbox.com/games/store/the-bus/9pj4vb2lml1q
